title.narrative: Apoyo a Poblaciones Vulnerables Afectadas por Coronavirus (COVID-19)
Support for Vulnerable Populations Affected by Coronavirus (COVID-19)

description.narrative: Contribuir a asegurar niveles mnimos de calidad de vida de las personas vulnerables frente a la crisis causada por el COVID-19. Los objetivos especficos son: (i)apoyar niveles mnimos de ingreso de personas afectadas por la Pandemia COVID-19, en el periodo inmediato y durante la recuperacin; y (ii)preservar el capital humano de las personas afectadas por la crisis de coronavirus.

Contribute to ensuring minimum levels of quality of life for vulnerable persons amid the crisis caused by COVID-19. The specific objective is to support minimum income for those affected by the coronavirus in the immediate period and during the recovery; and ii) preserve human capital of people affected by the coronavirus crisis.
Commitment in 2021-06-23
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2022
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2023
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2025
